set.body: Add a versioned lifecycle run envelope that references family-specific program, compiled-plan and fit records through typed schema, kind, identity and digest references. Runtime emitters must derive solver evidence, certificates, capabilities, training scope and provenance from a fitted lifecycle artifact. Acceptance: spectral, GLRM and aligned multiblock runtime fits emit valid bundles; cross-document references and hashes are checked; no public constructor can hand-author achieved evidence detached from a fit; v1 evidence remains decode-compatible; JVM and Scala.js codecs, schema fixtures and mutation tests pass.
set.title: Emit and validate universal ModelRun IR from runtime fits
